blocks.text: SEOUL — A meeting between Donald Trump and North Korean leader Kim Jong Un appears increasingly unlikely when the US president travels to Asia in November, analysts say, after he suffered a crushing midterm election defeat. Trump had said he “may” meet Kim this month and that it “would be exciting”, but appeared to backtrack
